summary: Full E2E test of AXIMBRA site. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass (root, email schema, lead schema, empty->422, long-input truncation, per-session 429 after 8 runs with Hungarian message). Frontend: page renders after intro (body.lock removed at ~3.45s), all 5 nav testids visible, hero buttons work, all 12 agent cards render, 2 live cards show 'Élő' badges and 'Próbáld ki élőben' buttons, both LIVE demos (email + lead) successfully returned populated Hungarian result grids with correct enums (kategoria=Reklamáció/surgosseg=Sürgős/felelos=Ügyfélszolgálat/valaszhatarido=4 órán belül, minosites=A + all 4 dimensions=Igazolt), 6 process steps + human-gate-pill present, 8 pricing rows, phone-card + episteme-link (target=_blank) + contact-email (mailto:aximbra@gmail.com) + contact-phone-disabled all present, nav gets 'scrolled' class on scroll. No console errors observed.

issues: When the E-mail rendező (or lead) card is expanded inline in a 3-column grid, the demo form/result block is much taller than sibling cards, leaving a large empty gap in the row and pushing next row down (only visible in wide viewports). Consider making the expanded card span full width or open in a proper modal.

critical_code_review_comments: Intro.jsx removes body.lock at delay+850ms (~3450ms), not ~2600ms as described in the request. Not a bug, but the spec description is slightly off; behaviour is fine.
Rate limiting is in-memory per process — will reset on backend restart. Fine for demo but worth noting for prod.
_call_llm uses model 'gpt-5.4-mini' (as configured by user); LLM responded correctly in Hungarian JSON matching strict Pydantic schemas.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limit tests consume 8+ LLM calls per session and ~9 requests toward the 20/hr IP cap. Wait at least 3.5s after page load for body.lock to be removed. To open live demos in UI, click [data-testid=agent-try-email] / agent-try-lead (agent-card-email click alone does not open the form since the whole card isn't clickable — only the button is). Playwright sample-click then run works; result grid selectors are demo-result-email / demo-result-lead.
